chip.description: Eight-voice mono wavetable generator reading 4-bit waveforms from PROM and streaming them into the companion 99XX DAC rather than converting on-die (taxonomy §4.13 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/namco.cpp in MAME 0.288 ("8-voice mono (custom 15XX: Mappy, Dig Dug 2, etc) ... The 15XX custom does not have a DAC of its own; instead, it streams the 4-bit PROM data directly into the 99XX custom DAC").
